name: crawlbrulee
description: official agent skills for crawlbrulee — turn any url into markdown, html, links, images, screenshots, and site maps.

interface.shortDescription: turn any url into markdown, html, links, images, screenshots, and site maps
interface.longDescription: crawlbrulee is a web-scraping api. you send a url and get back clean structured data: markdown, cleaned html, raw html, the page's links and images, a screenshot, and page metadata. you can also list the urls on a site before you scrape them. this plugin carries ten skills — one entry point, the shared api contract, one per capability (scrape, async scrape, map, screenshots), and one per interface (cli, mcp, js/ts sdk, python sdk) — so the agent knows which call to make and how to read the result.
defaultPrompt: scrape https://example.com with crawlbrulee and give me the markdown
use crawlbrulee to list the urls on example.com, then scrape the docs pages
take a full-page screenshot of https://example.com with crawlbrulee
